items.stem: What is the result of dividing 4.8 by 0.6 using the decimal division algorithm?
A recipe requires 3.6 liters of juice to make 4 batches of punch. How many liters of juice are needed for one batch?
Select ALL statements that correctly describe the process of dividing decimals using an algorithm. Show or explain your work.
choices: You can multiply both the divisor and dividend by the same power of 10 to make the divisor a whole number.
The decimal point in the quotient should be placed directly above the decimal point in the dividend.
You must always ignore the decimal points and divide the numbers as whole numbers.
Dividing a decimal by a decimal is the same as dividing by a fraction.
